description: Run SocialWTF's in-house Sentinel Shield preliminary keyword screening on a text snippet, filename, or media URL. Distinguishes preliminary keyword screening (analysisMethod: 'preliminary_keyword_screen', mediaInspected: false, verifiedMediaSafety: false, confidence: null) from verified media content inspection, and fails closed ('quarantined' or 'age_restricted') on uninspected binary media URLs or sensitive terms. Works with or without an account and modifies no state.

media.description: Text snippet, caption, filename, or media URL to evaluate with Sentinel Shield (1-2000 characters).

type.description: Optional declared content type ('text', 'image', 'video', or 'audio'). Binary media types fail closed unless inspected by a verified media classifier.

name: socialwtf_shield_scan

confidence.description: Classifier confidence score (0-1), or null when heuristic keyword screening is used.

isShielded.description: True if the content is restricted or quarantined behind a safety shield.

mediaInspected.description: True only when actual image/video/audio bytes were inspected by a media classifier.

publicFeedEligible.description: Whether the item is eligible for public feeds.

verifiedMediaSafety.description: True only when media safety is verified by content inspection (false for keyword-only screening).

title: Scan Content with Sentinel Shield Safety Classifier
